ω.def: the last letter of the Greek alphabet, i.e. (figuratively) the finality. KJV: Omega.
a primary interjection; as a sign of the vocative case, O; as a note of exclamation, oh. KJV: O.

the subjunctive of εἰμί (G1510); (may, might, can, could, would, should, must, etc.; also with εἰ (G1487) and its comparative, as well as with other particles) be. KJV: + appear, are, (may, might, should) be, X have, is, + pass the flower of her age, should stand, were.

ωβηδ.def: of Hebrew origin (H5744); Obed, an Israelite. KJV: Obed.

ωδε.def: from an adverb form of ὅδε (G3592); in this same spot, i.e. here or hither. KJV: here, hither, (in) this place, there.

ωδη.def: from ᾄδω (G103); a chant or "ode" (the general term for any words sung; while ὕμνος (G5215) denotes especially a religious metrical composition, and ψαλμός (G5568) still more specially, a Hebrew cantillation). KJV: song.

ωδιν.def: akin to ὀδύνη (G3601); a pang or throe, especially of childbirth. KJV: pain, sorrow, travail.

ωδινω.def: from ὠδίν (G5604); to experience the pains of parturition (literally or figuratively). KJV: travail in (birth).

ωμοσ.def: perhaps from the alternate of φέρω (G5342); the shoulder (as that on which burdens are borne). KJV: shoulder.

ων.def: present participle of εἰμί (G1510); being. KJV: be, come, have.

ωνεομαι.def: middle voice from an apparently primary ὦνος (a sum or price); to purchase (synonymous with the earlier πίμπρημι (G4092)). KJV: buy.

ωον.def: apparently a primary word; an "egg". KJV: egg.

ωρα.def: apparently a primary word; an "hour" (literally or figuratively). KJV: day, hour, instant, season, X short, (even-)tide, (high) time.

ωραιοσ.def: from ὥρα (G5610); belonging to the right hour or season (timely), i.e. (by implication) flourishing (beauteous (figuratively)). KJV: beautiful.

ωρυομαι.def: middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to "roar". KJV: roar.

ωσ.def: probably adverb of comparative from ὅς (G3739); which how, i.e. in that manner (very variously used, as follows). KJV: about, after (that), (according) as (it had been, it were), as soon (as), even as (like), for, how (greatly), like (as, unto), since, so (that), that, to wit, unto, when(-soever), while, X with all speed.

ωσαννα.def: of Hebrew origin (H3467 and H4994); oh save!; hosanna (i.e. hoshia-na), an exclamation of adoration. KJV: hosanna.

ωσαυτωσ.def: from ὡς (G5613) and an adverb from αὐτός (G846); as thus, i.e. in the same way. KJV: even so, likewise, after the same (in like) manner.

ωσει.def: from ὡς (G5613) and εἰ (G1487); as if. KJV: about, as (it had been, it were), like (as).

ωσηε.def: of Hebrew origin (H1954); Hosee (i.e. Hoshea), an Israelite. KJV: Osee.

ωσπερ.def: from ὡς (G5613) and περ (G4007); just as, i.e. exactly like. KJV: (even, like) as.

ωσπερει.def: from ὥσπερ (G5618) and εἰ (G1487); just as if, i.e. as it were. KJV: as.

ωστε.def: from ὡς (G5613) and τέ (G5037); so too, i.e. thus therefore (in various relations of consecution, as follow). KJV: (insomuch) as, so that (then), (insomuch) that, therefore, to, wherefore.

ωτιον.def: diminutive of οὖς (G3775); an earlet, i.e. one of the ears, or perhaps the lobe of the ear. KJV: ear.

ωφελεια.def: from a derivative of the base of ὠφέλιμος (G5624); usefulness, i.e. benefit. KJV: advantage, profit.

ωφελεω.def: from the same as ὠφέλεια (G5622); to be useful, i.e. to benefit. KJV: advantage, better, prevail, profit.

ωφελιμοσ.def: from a form of ὄφελος (G3786); helpful or serviceable, i.e. advantageous. KJV: profit(-able).
